values: 进入“变形”形态并对周围敌人造成伤害和嘲讽，变形期间消耗“火源”使其他技能效果增强。“火源”全部消耗后变回“本相”形态并对周围敌人造成伤害和致盲。

Hepler enters Altered Form, dealing damage to nearby enemies and taunting them. He also gains a set number of Spark stacks. While in Altered Form, his other skills are enhanced, but cost Spark stacks to cast. When Hepler runs out of Spark stacks, he reverts to his True Form, dealing damage to enemies and blinding them.

赫普进入“变形”形态，对自身周围2格所有敌人造成230% + 35% ATK伤害并嘲讽其持续5秒；同时获得4点“火源”。
赫普在“变形”形态下技能“倾囊相授”和“紧急避险”获得强化且冷却时间更短，但释放时需要消耗1点“火源”。“火源”全部消耗后赫普变回“本相”形态，同时对周围2格所有敌人造成230% + 35% ATK伤害并使其致盲持续5秒。

Hepler enters Altered Form, dealing 230% + 35% ATK damage to all enemies within 2 tiles and taunting them for 5s. He also gains 4 Spark stacks.
While Hepler is in Altered Form, Remedial Class and Extra Credit are enhanced and have shorter cooldowns, but each costs 1 Spark stack to cast. When Hepler runs out of Spark stacks, he reverts to his True Form, dealing 230% + 35% ATK damage to all enemies within 2 tiles and blinding them for 5s.
进入“变形”形态时造成的伤害提升至260% + 35% ATK，变回“本相”形态时造成的伤害提升至260% + 35% ATK。
Increases the damage dealt when entering Altered Form to 260% + 35% ATK, and increases the damage dealt when reverting to True Form to 260% + 35% ATK.
进入“变形”形态时造成的伤害提升至290% + 35% ATK，变回“本相”形态时造成的伤害提升至290% + 35% ATK。
Increases the damage dealt when entering Altered Form to 290% + 35% ATK, and increases the damage dealt when reverting to True Form to 290% + 35% ATK.
进入“变形”形态时造成的伤害提升至320% + 35% ATK，变回“本相”形态时造成的伤害提升至320% + 35% ATK。
Increases the damage dealt when entering Altered Form to 320% + 35% ATK, and increases the damage dealt when reverting to True Form to 320% + 35% ATK.
进入“变形”形态时造成的伤害提升至350% + 35% ATK，变回“本相”形态时造成的伤害提升至350% + 35% ATK。
Increases the damage dealt when entering Altered Form to 350% + 35% ATK, and increases the damage dealt when reverting to True Form to 350% + 35% ATK.
“本相”形态：对单体敌人造成伤害，并降低高额急速。“变形”形态：造成范围伤害，并击晕敌人。
While in True Form, Hepler deals damage to a single enemy and greatly reduces their Haste. While in Altered Form, Hepler deals AoE damage and stuns enemies.

“本相”形态：赫普使用法术痛击敌人，对目标造成300% + 30% ATK伤害，同时降低目标60点急速持续3 + 0.3秒。
“变形”形态：赫普重击目标敌人，对目标及其周围1格内的敌人造成360% + 45% ATK伤害并使其眩晕3 + 0.3秒。

While in True Form, Hepler unleashes destructive magic at an enemy, dealing 300% + 30% ATK damage and reducing the target's Haste by 60 for 3 + 0.3s.
While in Altered Form, Hepler strikes the target with powerful blows, dealing 360% + 45% ATK damage to the target and enemies within 1 tile around them, and stunning them for 3 + 0.3s.
“本相”形态：降低的急速提升至70点；“变形”形态：造成的伤害提升至390% + 45% ATK。
While in True Form, increases the Haste reduction from Hepler's magic attack to 70. While in Altered Form, increases the damage of Hepler's powerful blow to 390% + 45% ATK.
“本相”形态：降低的急速提升至80点；“变形”形态：造成的伤害提升至420% + 45% ATK。
While in True Form, increases the Haste reduction from Hepler's magic attack to 80. While in Altered Form, increases the damage of Hepler's powerful blow to 420% + 45% ATK.
“本相”形态：降低的急速提升至90点；“变形”形态：造成的伤害提升至450% + 45% ATK。
While in True Form, increases the Haste reduction from Hepler's magic attack to 90. While in Altered Form, increases the damage of Hepler's powerful blow to 450% + 45% ATK.
“本相”形态：使一名友军持续恢复生命。“变形”形态：使多名友军持续恢复生命并获得护盾。
While in True Form, Hepler continuously heals 1 ally. While in Altered Form, Hepler continuously heals multiple allies and grants them shields.

“本相”形态：赫普对最虚弱的友军施加治愈术，使目标在6秒内每秒恢复130% + 16% ATK生命值。
“变形”形态：赫普对最虚弱的3名友军施加治愈术和坚硬皮肤，使目标在6秒内每秒恢复130% + 16% ATK生命值，并使其获得400% + 64% ATK护盾，持续15秒。

While in True Form, Hepler casts a healing spell on the weakest ally, healing them for 130% + 16% ATK HP per second for 6s.
While in Altered Form, Hepler casts a healing spell on the 3 weakest allies and grants them toughened skin, healing them for 130% + 16% ATK HP per second for 6s and granting them a 400% + 64% ATK shield for 15s.
治愈术每秒恢复的生命值提升至140% + 16% ATK；坚硬皮肤提供的护盾值提升至480% + 64% ATK。
Increases HP restored by the healing spell to 140% + 16% ATK per second and the shield value gained from toughened skin to 480% + 64% ATK.
治愈术每秒恢复的生命值提升至150% + 16% ATK；坚硬皮肤提供的护盾值提升至560% + 64% ATK。
Increases HP restored by the healing spell to 150% + 16% ATK per second and the shield value gained from toughened skin to 560% + 64% ATK.
治愈术每秒恢复的生命值提升至160% + 16% ATK；坚硬皮肤提供的护盾值提升至640% + 64% ATK。
Increases HP restored by the healing spell to 160% + 16% ATK per second and the shield value gained from toughened skin to 640% + 64% ATK.
降低自身受到伤害，处于“变形”形态时额外降低自身受到伤害。
Reduces damage taken. While in Altered Form, further reduces the damage taken.
战斗中，自身受到伤害降低9%。处于“变形”形态时，使自身受到伤害额外降低6%。
Reduces damage taken by 9% during battle. While in Altered Form, further reduces damage taken by 6%.
战斗中，自身受到伤害降低12%。处于“变形”形态时，使自身受到伤害额外降低8%。
Reduces damage taken by 12% during battle. While in Altered Form, further reduces damage taken by 8%.
战斗中，自身受到伤害降低15%。处于“变形”形态时，使自身受到伤害额外降低10%。
Reduces damage taken by 15% during battle. While in Altered Form, further reduces damage taken by 10%.
保护一名英雄，使其免疫首次受到的最后一击，为其施加护盾和治疗，同时将其暂时变形躲向战场后方。
Hepler protects 1 allied hero from the first fatal blow they would take, grants them healing and a shield, then briefly transforms them into an animal that runs toward the back of the battlefield.
战斗开始时保护一名在自身周围一格范围内最靠前的其他友方英雄：当其首次受到最后一击时，使其免疫这次伤害，同时赫普为其施加持续5秒的治愈术和坚硬皮肤，并使其变为小动物逃向战场后方，小动物状态下该友军进入无敌状态，持续3秒。

When a battle starts, Hepler protects the frontmost adjacent allied hero. The first time that ally would take a fatal blow, they instead ignore the damage. At the same time, Hepler heals the ally and grants them toughened skin for 5s, and transforms them into a small animal that runs toward the back of the battlefield. While in animal form, the ally becomes invincible for 3s.
该技能提供的治愈术和坚硬皮肤的持续时间提升至7秒。
Increases the duration of healing and toughened skin granted by this skill to 7s.
赫普提高相当于被保护队友30%初始攻击力的攻击力，该队友获得相当于赫普40%初始生命值的最大生命值。赫普通过该技能获得的攻击力最高不超过自身初始攻击力的80%。

Hepler gains ATK equal to 30% of the protected ally's initial ATK, while that ally gains max HP equal to 40% of Hepler's initial HP. The ATK Hepler gains from this skill cannot exceed 80% of his own initial ATK.
该技能提供的治愈术和坚硬皮肤的持续时间提升至9秒。
Increases the duration of healing and toughened skin granted by this skill to 9s.
消耗“火源”时使自身和被保护的队友提升护甲、魔抗并降低受到的伤害。
Whenever Hepler spends Spark stacks, he and the protected ally permanently increase their Phys & Magic DEF and reduce their damage taken.
赫普每次消耗“火源”时，使自身和被保护的队友永久获得6%护甲和魔抗加成，同时受到的伤害降低3%，最多可叠加10层。
Whenever Hepler spends Spark stacks, he and the protected ally permanently increase their Phys & Magic DEF by 6% and reduce their damage taken by 3%, stacking up to 10 times.
